title: Learning Bidirectional Causal Interactions with Heteroscedastic Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2607.22313v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Estimating contemporaneous bidirectional interactions from observational data is difficult because each outcome is endogenous to the other, while flexible regressions may capture only reduced-form dependence. This paper proposes SEM-DNN, a heteroscedastic neural simultaneous-equation estimator that learns reciprocal structural interactions without external instruments. Identification exploits conditional covariance diagonalization: when structural shocks have zero conditional means, are conditionally uncorrelated given predetermined covariates, and exhibit nonproportional conditional variances, only the true interaction coefficients diagonalize the conditional residual covariance across the feature space. The method jointly approximates nonlinear structural mean functions and feature-dependent variances using a diagonal Gaussian quasi-likelihood that incorporates the simultaneous-system Jacobian. translated_title: 基于异方差神经网络学习双向因果交互
translated_abstract: 从观测数据中估计同期双向交互作用是困难的，因为每个结果变量相对于另一方都是内生的，而灵活的回归可能只能捕捉到简化形式的依赖关系。本文提出了 SEM-DNN，一种异方差神经联立方程估计器，能够在没有外部工具变量的情况下学习互惠的结构性交互作用。其识别策略利用了条件协方差对角化：当结构冲击具有零条件均值、在给定前定协变量的条件下互不相关、且表现出非成比例的条件方差时，只有真实的交互系数才能在整个特征空间上使条件残差协方差对角化。该方法使用对角高斯拟似然来联合逼近非线性结构均值函数和依赖于特征的方差，该拟似然中融入了联立方程系统的雅可比矩阵。我们建立了唯一识别性……
tldr: 提出无需外部工具变量的异方差神经联立方程估计器 SEM-DNN，通过条件协方差对角化实现观测数据中双向同期因果交互的唯一识别与非线性联合估计。
en_tdlr: Proposes SEM-DNN, a heteroscedastic neural simultaneous-equation estimator that uniquely identifies and jointly estimates bidirectional contemporaneous causal interactions from observational data without external instruments, via conditional covariance diagonalization.
